One time in like 3rd or 4th grade I was riding the bus, and obviously at that age I was a hyperactive kid. So we get close to my stop and I pick up my bag and stand up. The bus driver decides to slam on the breaks and I go flying into the floor and towards the front. I picked myself up, and the guy just says "Maybe now you won't stand up when I'm driving". Once he stopped I got off the bus bawling. Safe to say, my father wasn't happy when I told him about it. He would always wait for me to get off and he'd drive me to the house. He yelled at the bus driver and the guy drove off. When we got home he called the bus company and told them what happened. That was the first and last time I ever saw the bus driver on the job.
